name: Yuna World
storyline:
Yuna World – The Unwritten Dawn

After your death, the goddess Yuna grants you a second life in Aetheria. But this world is losing its memories: names vanish, people are forgotten, and nobody seems to notice.

Only you exist outside this mysterious fate. Together with new companions, explore the Tower of Echoes and uncover the truth behind the disappearances.

Discover a story of humor, friendship, and mystery, told through an expanding chapter-based adventure with visual novel dialogue and three reply choices.
summary:
An accident ends your old life, but the goddess Yuna offers you a second chance. Welcome to Aetheria, a fantasy world filled with monsters, magic, and new companions, where your destination is the mysterious Tower of Trials. Choose from four character classes and forge your own playstyle: develop your attributes, master powerful skills, and discover equipment to prepare for the challenges ahead. In turn-based combat, your abilities and tactical choices make the difference between victory and defeat.

Climb the tower alone or join forces with up to three other players. Defeat formidable bosses, collect loot, and grow stronger together. Summon companions, earn special titles, and make your mark on the leaderboards.
